title: Sun Meaning
overview: The Sun describes identity, vitality, creative force, visibility, and the part of life that wants to be lived with purpose. It shows where someone builds confidence, recognizes what gives them energy, and learns to act from the center of themselves rather than from imitation or approval.
cycle: The Sun moves through all twelve signs once each year and spends about one month in each sign. Its sign describes the style of identity and vitality; its house shows where that life force seeks expression and recognition.

signs.body: With your Sun in Aries, you radiate energy and courage. You have a pioneering spirit, a love of competition, and a knack for initiating new projects. You value your independence and aren't afraid to walk your path boldly and confidently.

As a Taurus Sun, you exude steadiness, reliability, and a deep connection with the physical world. You appreciate beauty and comfort, and you're likely to build a life that engages your senses. You show your tenacity in achieving goals and can be quite unyielding once your mind is set.

With your Sun in Gemini, you embody versatility, curiosity, and a need for variety. Communication is your forte, and you shine when sharing ideas or gathering knowledge. Your mutable nature makes you adaptable, and you're often drawn to activities that involve a fair degree of mental stimulation.

As a Cancer Sun, you exude nurturing energy and emotional sensitivity. You highly value family and home and take pride in caring for loved ones. You're guided by your emotions and intuition, and you have an innate ability to provide comfort and security to those around you.

With your Sun in Leo, you radiate warmth, generosity, and a zest for life. Your presence is often magnetic, drawing others to you naturally. You shine when expressing your creativity and have a strong drive for personal recognition and a desire to be at the center of attention.

As a Virgo Sun, you personify efficiency, practicality, and a focus on service. You're detail-oriented and often drawn to tasks that involve analysis or helping others. You shine when precision and care are needed, and your work ethic is second to none.

With your Sun in Libra, you reflect balance, harmony, and a knack for partnership. You are socially oriented, often striving to create peace and fairness in your surroundings. Your charm and diplomatic skills allow you to navigate relationships with grace and ease.

As a Scorpio Sun, you emanate depth, transformation, and intensity. You thrive on emotional intimacy and are unafraid to dive into life's mysteries. Your determination is unyielding, and your passions run deep, allowing you to navigate life's ups and downs with resilience.

With your Sun in Sagittarius, you reflect a love of freedom, adventure, and truth-seeking. You're drawn to exploring life's big questions and aren't afraid to travel far and wide in your search for answers. Your optimistic nature and broad-minded outlook make you a natural philosopher.

As a Capricorn Sun, you exude discipline, ambition, and a strong sense of responsibility. You have a natural knack for management and strategy, and you shine when setting long-term goals. Your practical and cautious approach to life is often a model of success for others.

With your Sun in Aquarius, you embody individuality, innovation, and a deep sense of humanitarianism. You thrive on uniqueness and often seek to challenge the status quo. You shine in situations where you can utilize your inventive mind and make a difference in the world.

As a Pisces Sun, you emanate empathy, spiritual depth, and a strong intuitive sense. You are in tune with the collective unconscious and often show a selfless desire to help others. Your imaginative and compassionate nature allows you to navigate the world with grace and sensitivity.

source.title: As Above, So Below: A Guide to Astrology for Tarot Readers
